_comment: Human-defined target feature framework for the Neobanking category (category_id=36 in production), approved by Brian 2026-08-24 after reviewing the raw 8/23 origination scan output. scripts/remap_queue_to_framework.py must not add, remove, or rename any bucket; it only decides which pending feature_review_queue proposals map to which bucket (or to none). Each bucket's 'name' is the exact canonical feature name to write back to the queue item's payload.feature.name — do not let the model paraphrase it. 'hint' is matching guidance only (disambiguation for a human/LLM reviewer), not part of the stored feature name or definition. Revised 2026-08-24 after Brian reviewed the first preview run's plan (nothing had been --apply'd yet): removed 'Mobile banking' (general app access, not CFO-relevant), added 'Mobile check deposit' (the specific useful mobile capability — the preview's denied item #396, already a 2-tool merge from origination, belongs here instead) and 'General ledger / accounting software sync' (a real, well-supported feature the first pass wrongly excluded — the preview's denied item #421, already an 8-tool merge, belongs here; kept distinct from the existing 'Accounting services' bucket, which is bookkeeping/tax-adjacent, a different concept). Confirmed correct as denied, unchanged in this revision: 'Financial statement reporting' (#484, universal table stakes, not differentiating) and 'Multi-currency invoicing' (#453, too niche for this list) — both from the first preview run, neither is a bucket here.

buckets.name: Business bank accounts
buckets.hint: The core FDIC-insured (or partner-bank) checking/operating account itself — opening and holding company funds. Not a specific sub-type below.

buckets.name: Yield-bearing accounts (interest, sweep, money market)
buckets.hint: Interest paid on cash balances, sweep programs into money-market funds, or similar yield mechanisms on idle cash.

buckets.name: Deposit insurance & FDIC coverage
buckets.hint: Expanded/extended FDIC coverage via sweep networks, multi-bank programs, or insurance partnerships — the safety/coverage claim itself, not the account it sits on.

buckets.name: Multi-entity management
buckets.hint: Managing multiple separate legal entities (subsidiaries, portfolio companies, franchises) under one login/platform.

buckets.name: Sub-account support
buckets.hint: Creating multiple sub-accounts/buckets WITHIN one entity for budgeting, project tracking, or fund segregation — distinct from multi-entity management, which is about separate legal entities.

buckets.name: Mobile check deposit
buckets.hint: Depositing a paper check by photographing it via a phone camera — a specific, genuinely useful mobile capability. Distinct from general mobile app account access (not its own bucket in this framework).

buckets.name: ACH / wire payments
buckets.hint: Standard domestic ACH and wire transfer send/receive capability.

buckets.name: Real-time / instant payments
buckets.hint: RTP, FedNow, same-day/instant push-to-card, or other real-time settlement rails — distinct from standard ACH/wire.

buckets.name: Cross-border transfers
buckets.hint: Sending/receiving payments internationally — the payment-rail mechanics, distinct from foreign exchange conversion itself (bucket 20) and holding foreign-currency balances (bucket 21).

buckets.name: Customer invoicing (recurring/scheduled)
buckets.hint: Creating and sending invoices to customers, including recurring/scheduled billing — accounts receivable side.

buckets.name: Vendor bill capture and pay (embedded AP)
buckets.hint: Capturing vendor bills (upload/email/OCR) and paying them — embedded accounts payable workflow, distinct from the invoicing (AR) bucket above and from bulk payouts below.

buckets.name: Bulk payouts
buckets.hint: Sending many payments at once to a batch of recipients (marketplace/gig payouts, mass disbursements) — distinct from paying individual vendor bills.

buckets.name: Card issuance (basic — physical/virtual, issuing to team)
buckets.hint: The baseline capability of issuing physical and virtual debit/charge cards to team members. If a proposal is specifically about charge-card credit terms, rewards, or vendor-scoped virtual cards, use the more specific bucket below instead.

buckets.name: Charge cards
buckets.hint: Corporate charge cards specifically (pay-in-full credit facility), as distinct from basic debit card issuance.

buckets.name: Cash back rewards
buckets.hint: Cash-back or rewards earned on card spend.

buckets.name: Vendor-specific virtual cards
buckets.hint: Virtual cards restricted/locked to a specific vendor or merchant, as distinct from general-purpose virtual card issuance.

buckets.name: Spend controls & payment approval workflows
buckets.hint: Setting spend limits/rules on cards or payments and multi-step approval workflows before a payment or card transaction goes through.

buckets.name: Spend budgets and analytics
buckets.hint: Setting departmental/category budgets and reporting/analyzing actual spend against them — a reporting/planning capability, distinct from real-time transaction-level approval controls above.

buckets.name: Role-based access control / permissions
buckets.hint: Granular user roles and permissions within the platform itself (who can see/do what) — a platform-administration capability, not a payment-approval workflow.

buckets.name: Foreign exchange services
buckets.hint: Currency conversion / FX trading capability itself.

buckets.name: Foreign bank accounts
buckets.hint: Holding actual foreign-currency-denominated bank accounts (multi-currency accounts), distinct from a one-off FX conversion or a cross-border payment rail.

buckets.name: Banking and payments API
buckets.hint: General-purpose API for banking/payment operations (accounts, transfers) — the broad platform API, not the more specific card-issuing or invoicing APIs below.

buckets.name: Card issuing API
buckets.hint: An API specifically for programmatically issuing/managing cards.

buckets.name: Customer invoicing API
buckets.hint: An API specifically for programmatically creating/managing customer invoices.

buckets.name: Webhooks and read-only APIs
buckets.hint: Read-only data access APIs and webhook/event-notification support, as distinct from the write/action APIs above.

buckets.name: Sandbox environments
buckets.hint: A test/sandbox environment for developers building against the API.

buckets.name: Audit logging
buckets.hint: A log/trail of user and system actions for audit/compliance purposes.

buckets.name: Fraud detection services
buckets.hint: Automated fraud/anomaly detection on transactions or account activity.

buckets.name: Financing services
buckets.hint: General lending/financing products offered (loans, lines of credit) as a category — use Credit underwriting below specifically when the proposal is about the underwriting/decisioning mechanism.

buckets.name: Credit underwriting (working capital and other)
buckets.hint: The underwriting/decisioning process for extending credit (working capital, revenue-based financing, etc.), as distinct from simply offering financing services.

buckets.name: SAFE issuance
buckets.hint: Issuing/managing SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity) instruments — a startup-fundraising-specific capability.

buckets.name: Accounting services
buckets.hint: Bundled/outsourced bookkeeping or accounting-as-a-service offered alongside the banking product — a different concept from the sync bucket below: this is done-FOR-you bookkeeping, not a data connection to a GL tool the customer already runs.

buckets.name: General ledger / accounting software sync
buckets.hint: Syncing transactions/balances with an external accounting/GL platform the customer already uses (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite) — a data-connection capability, distinct from 'Accounting services' (bundled bookkeeping done by the bank itself).

buckets.name: Rule-based account transfers
buckets.hint: Automated, rule-driven money movement between accounts/sub-accounts (e.g. auto-sweep by rule) — distinct from accounting categorization/tagging below.

buckets.name: Employee expense reimbursements
buckets.hint: Reimbursing employees for out-of-pocket expenses, as distinct from company card spend.

buckets.name: Receipt capture, extraction, and transaction matching
buckets.hint: Capturing receipts (photo/email/upload), extracting their data, and matching them to transactions.

buckets.name: Automatic transaction categorization
buckets.hint: Automatically assigning a spend/GL category to a transaction.

buckets.name: Accounting class and dimension tagging
buckets.hint: Tagging transactions with accounting dimensions (class, location, department, project) beyond a basic category — distinct from the categorization bucket above.

buckets.name: 1099 contractor tax filing
buckets.hint: Preparing/filing 1099 tax forms for contractor payments.

buckets.name: Cash flow dashboard
buckets.hint: A dashboard/visualization of current and historical cash position — the reporting view itself, distinct from forward-looking forecasting below.

buckets.name: Cash flow forecasting
buckets.hint: Projecting future cash position, as distinct from a dashboard of current/historical cash.

buckets.name: Finance analyst agent (AI assistant)
buckets.hint: A conversational/agentic AI assistant that answers finance questions or performs analyst-style tasks — this is the ONE bucket in this framework where the underlying capability is expected to be AI-driven; the stored feature NAME still must not contain the word "AI" per docs/FEATURE_TAXONOMY.md §3 naming rules (ai_enabled on the link carries that signal instead).
